scripts.install: concurrently "npm run install:backend" "npm run install:frontend" && npm run db:setup
scripts.seed: cd backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx ts-node src/database/seed.ts
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:wait && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx ts-node src/database/migrate.ts
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml down -v && npm run db:setup
